items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: That's what my brother would be doing when we put on these shows.

ctx.x: That chord -- let me see. And he's cutting all kind of -- and sometimes while this is going on he's talking. And he's really talking and dancing all at the same time. That's what my brother would be doing when we put on these shows. We'd put these shows on and when one would sing we would have to play the accompaniment, play the accompaniment and each -- well, sometimes we would have duets together and I would have to sing the second part and he would sing the lead.
